must_supply: CSV of timestamped Vegas weekly prop snapshots at WEEKLY_EVAL_PROPS_PATH or output/shadow_vegas_props_compare/live_snapshots.csv
player_id matching the M3 / sealed board (gsis-style ids such as 00-0034857), not dry-run names (p-qb / p-wr)
season, week, market using Role 2 names (pass_yards, rec_yards, receptions, ...)
as_of (ISO-8601 UTC) and kickoff_at with as_of <= kickoff_at
line or implied_mean; implied_p_over when de-vig is available
optional outcomes CSV after the week: player_id, season, week, market, actual
live_data_blocker.note: Role 1 weekly_props snapshots live in the DB / artifact store, not as committed as_of CSVs. Export a leakage-safe Role 2 frame before kickoff; do not reuse a later closing line as the historical as-of.

caveat: 2026 sealed-board Role 2 export has no live timestamped Vegas snapshots in-repo. n_matched=0 is a live-data blocker, not a silent fixture mismatch. See vegas_props_compare_m3_dry_run.json for the matching harness (n_matched>0).
